Question 28
?

Use a fundamental vector product to determine which of the following integrals gives the surface area generated when the curve y=ln⁡z is rotated by 2π radians about the z-axis for z∈[1,e].

a
2π∫1e1z1+ln⁡zdz
b
2π∫1e1z21+ln⁡zdz
c
2π∫1eln⁡z1+1z2dz
d
2π∫1eln⁡z1+1zdz
e
2π∫1eln2⁡z1+1zdz
Don't Know
Submit
